data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: zero
sections.summary: the number 0; representing none or nothing

senses.definition: the number 0; representing none or nothing
examples: The temperature outside is zero degrees today.
She scores zero in the test because she gets no answers right.

answers.answer: The temperature outside is zero degrees today.
A triangle has zero sides.
Zero comes after one when you count.
Zero plus one equals zero.

senses.definition: the number 100; the result of ten times ten
examples: There are one hundred centimetres in one metre.
She saves one hundred pounds in her bank account.

answers.answer: There are one hundred centimetres in one metre.
A year has one hundred months.
One hundred comes after one thousand when you count.
Ten times ten equals one hundred and ten.

sections.title: one thousand
sections.summary: the number 1,000; ten times one hundred

senses.definition: the number 1,000; the result of ten times one hundred
examples: There are one thousand metres in one kilometre.
She reads one thousand words every day to improve her English.

answers.answer: There are one thousand metres in one kilometre.
One thousand is smaller than one hundred.
Ten times ten equals one thousand.
A year has one thousand days.

sections.title: one hundred and one
sections.summary: the number 101; one more than one hundred

senses.definition: the number 101; one more than one hundred
examples: The school has one hundred and one students this year.
She counts one hundred and one sheep before she falls asleep.

answers.answer: The school has one hundred and one students this year.
One hundred and one is smaller than one hundred.
One hundred and one equals one hundred minus one.
One hundred and one comes between ninety and one hundred.

sections.title: eleven
sections.summary: the number 11; one more than ten

senses.definition: the number 11; one more than ten
examples: A football team has eleven players on the field.
She wakes up at eleven o'clock on Saturday mornings.

answers.answer: A football team has eleven players on the field.
Eleven comes between nine and ten when you count.
There are eleven months in a year.
Ten plus two equals eleven.

sections.title: twelve
sections.summary: the number 12; one more than eleven

senses.definition: the number 12; one more than eleven
examples: There are twelve months in a year.
She buys twelve eggs at the store.

answers.answer: There are twelve months in a year.
Twelve comes before eleven when you count.
Ten plus three equals twelve.
A year has twelve weeks.

sections.title: thirteen
sections.summary: the number 13; one more than twelve

senses.definition: the number 13; one more than twelve
examples: She is thirteen years old and goes to secondary school.
He counts thirteen birds sitting on the wall.

answers.answer: She is thirteen years old and goes to secondary school.
Thirteen comes between eleven and twelve when you count.
Ten plus four equals thirteen.
Thirteen is less than twelve.

sections.title: fourteen
sections.summary: the number 14; one more than thirteen

senses.definition: the number 14; one more than thirteen
examples: There are fourteen days in two weeks.
She has fourteen books on her shelf.

answers.answer: There are fourteen days in two weeks.
Fourteen comes before thirteen when you count.
Ten plus five equals fourteen.
There are fourteen months in a year.

sections.title: fifteen
sections.summary: the number 15; one more than fourteen

senses.definition: the number 15; one more than fourteen
examples: There are fifteen students in the class today.
She finishes her homework in fifteen minutes.

answers.answer: There are fifteen students in the class today.
Ten plus six equals fifteen.
Fifteen comes between thirteen and fourteen when you count.
Fifteen is the same as twelve plus four.

sections.title: sixteen
sections.summary: the number 16; one more than fifteen

senses.definition: the number 16; one more than fifteen
examples: She turns sixteen years old on her birthday next week.
He counts sixteen cars in the car park.

answers.answer: She turns sixteen years old on her birthday next week.
Ten plus five equals sixteen.
Sixteen comes before fifteen when you count.
There are sixteen hours in a day.
